newsitem.title: CHINA: China bank signs 150 mln guilder credit quota.
newsitem.headline: China bank signs 150 mln guilder credit quota.

text.p: The Agricultural Bank of China has signed an export credit quota worth 150 million guilders with Rabobank Nederland, Chinese bank officials said on Monday.
"The agreement was signed last Friday in Beijing," said an official of the agricultural bank.
"The agreement was just a framework, or a credit quota," a second bank official said.
Under the agreement, the Agricultural Bank could apply to the Netherlands-based bank for loans within the credit line in a five-year period, he said.
"The credit quota may not be fully used and could be extended," the official said. It was the first such agreement between the Agricultural Bank of China and Rabobank Nederland.
The export credit was designed to promote exports of capital goods and services of the Netherlands to China, he said, but gave no further details.
